Body weight at which the exchange flows of the tissue distribution (ftissue_<sid>) are given; they scale with the body weight as the volumes and the blood flows do. The liver volume scales with the body surface area relative to BSA_ref.
Body surface area of the reference BW_ref and HEIGHT_ref.
1.0: normal function; <1.0: reduced function as reduced cardiac output;
